title: The Black Lotus - Eon - Amiga Demo (50 FPS)
summary: Eon is a demoscene production by The Black Lotus, released at Revision 2019 and designed for an Amiga with OCS chipset, 512 kB chip and 512 kB fast memory. This is the party version, which has some known glitches.
why: HN holds it up as a showcase of what a stock Amiga 500 can do and as one of the best demos ever in technique and storytelling.

quote.text: I feel like this is one of the best demos of all time from both a technical point of view plus storytelling.
